text: The accepted flat ESLint config extends Mozilla valid-jsdoc and permits custom-element attribute/cssproperty/part/slot/tagname tags. The historical global .eslintrc rollout removed nested rule copies; those old config paths are no longer the current control surface. Syntax lint does not establish correct nullability, Promise wrapping, callback ownership or actual parameter values. Use source/caller checks for those manual review concerns. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.
title: Keep global JSDoc lint support separate from semantic documentation quality
